newsitem.title: FRANCE: Prodi says to rebuff criticism of lira - paper.
newsitem.headline: Prodi says to rebuff criticism of lira - paper.

text.p: Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi said he would not accept any further criticism from French President Jacques Chirac about the lira, daily Le Figaro reported on Wednesday.

When asked in an interview what he would do if Chirac reiterated his since-retracted criticism of the lira when he and Prodi meet tonight and Friday for a summit in Naples, Italy, he said "I would let him know that the lira today is quite different from the lira to which he was referring. We must be clear and I will be.
"Jacques Chirac is a subtle enough politician to understand how important it is for France and Italy to cooperate on solid ground," Prodi said.

Earlier this week, Chirac blamed the lira's weakness for hurting the French textile industry. He backed down later and said he hoped the lira would be a founding member of European economic and monetary union.
